card.title: BUNKER
card.text: A bunker is a reinforced structure used for protection against heavy fire.
card.flavorText: A bunker is a fortified shelter built to protect soldiers and equipment from artillery and bombs. Most are underground or partly dug into the earth. In WWII, bunkers ranged from small concrete trench shelters to massive coastal gun positions with walls several meters thick. Reinforced concrete and heavy earth cover helped deflect blast waves and survive intense bombardment. Strong doors and ventilation were essential for prolonged defense.
